description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.5.9-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed album year only coming from the first song
- Fixed albums stuck with year 0
- Fixed saving lyrics, ratings or tags erasing the date in the file
- Fixed artist page tiles showing year 0
- Fixed album page tiles showing year 0
- Fixed blurry covers on album, lyrics, artist and mini player
- Fixed no sound on Lyrics Studio Preview
- Fixed Lyrics Studio freezing when picking a song
- Fixed missing song title during Time every word
- Fixed choppy Drift and Kawarp sliders
- Fixed stray line and misleading message on the Plugins page
Added
- Added Albums Type filter remembering your choice
- Added Shuffle buttons turning on the bottom bar shuffle
- Added Movement, Saturation and Blur sliders for Drift background
- Added View Album and View Artist to Home track right-click
- Added Kugou, Musixmatch and YouTube Music lyric sources
- Added Auto lyric source that picks the best result
- Added full-size album cover viewer
- Added Mixxx plugin for BPM and key import
- Added Get plugins list with Install button in Settings
Improved
- Improved Search Lyrics pop-up layout and animation
- Improved Lyrics Studio top-right buttons
- Improved Lyrics Studio word row and line shift controls
- Improved Lyrics Studio Choose songs with explicit tags
- Improved Plugins page layout and wording
- Improved cover sharpness across the app
Full Changelog: v1.5.8...v1.5.9
